name: LYNX® Professional Ventana 36" Stainless Steel Sealed Pantry
shortDescription: Combining beauty with functionality, smooth front facings, recessed handles, and handcrafted framing merge to form a sleek and contemporary balance to your Lynx outdoor kitchen. Dust and water resistant, each door and drawer softly closes itself as if to punctuate the elegance of an artistic statement. The Ventana Collection from Lynx proves that small things can make a big difference.
metaDescription: Lynx® Professional Series 36" Sealed Pantry with full extension glide out drawers and adjustable wire shelf

features.text: Unique elegance—part of the Ventana Collection, the finest storage solutions for outdoor kitchens
Complete access—full-extension glide-out drawer slides for access to the back of the drawer
Clean storage—the magnetic gasket ensures a tight seal against outdoor elements
Spacious room—storage is 31 by 18 by 23 inches
Perennial refinement—clean design eliminates places that dirt can collect
May require Lynx Accessory Switch Kit for power supply (LASK)
